source_text: Uhh... Sorry. I’m Detective Canmore.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx#>.Uhh... Sorry. I’m Detective Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx#>.Uhh... Sorry. I’m Detective Canmore."

translation: Eee… Przepraszam. Jestem detektyw Canmore.

source_text: Wrong changing room, Detective Handsome.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.Wrong changing room, Detective Handsome.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.Wrong changing room, Detective Handsome."

translation: Pomyliłeś szatnie, przystojny detektywie.

source_text: Is that really what you’re wearing in the interview?

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Is that really what you’re wearing in the interview?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Is that really what you’re wearing in the interview?"

translation: Naprawdę zamierzasz tak wystąpić w wywiadzie?

source_text: Paul told me to change into something with a tie… but no jacket.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Paul told me to change into something with a tie… but no jacket.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Paul told me to change into something with a tie… but no jacket."

translation: Paul kazał mi założyć coś z krawatem… ale bez marynarki.

source_text: You better do what he says.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.You better do what he says.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.You better do what he says."

translation: Lepiej go posłuchaj.

source_text: So… Where should I go?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.So… Where should I go?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.So… Where should I go?"

translation: No więc… Dokąd mam iść?

source_text: You’re in over your head, aren’t you?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.You’re in over your head, aren’t you?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.You’re in over your head, aren’t you?"

translation: Trochę cię to przerasta, co?

source_text: I’ve never met a celebrity in person before.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.I’ve never met a celebrity in person before.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.I’ve never met a celebrity in person before."

translation: Nigdy wcześniej nie spotkałem osobiście żadnej gwiazdy.

source_text: First time on TV?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.First time on TV?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.First time on TV?"

translation: Pierwszy raz w telewizji?

source_text: Well, aren’t you cute?

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Well, aren’t you cute?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Well, aren’t you cute?"

translation: No proszę, jaki słodziak.

source_text: Can you help me out, Miss Foxx?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Can you help me out, Miss Foxx?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Can you help me out, Miss Foxx?"

translation: Może mi pani pomóc, panno Foxx?

source_text: Let’s see. How can we turn this high school dropout look into something more professional?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp#.Let’s see. How can we turn this high school dropout look into something more professional?
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp#.Let’s see. How can we turn this high school dropout look into something more professional?"

translation: Zobaczmy. Jak zmienić ten wygląd licealnego nieuka na coś bardziej profesjonalnego?

source_text: Are you going to wear that gold dress?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Are you going to wear that gold dress?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Are you going to wear that gold dress?"

translation: Założysz tę złotą sukienkę?

source_text: This old dress? Hell, no!

structure.raw_value: KiShOp.This old dress? Hell, no!
structure.script_literal: "KiShOp.This old dress? Hell, no!"

translation: Tę starą sukienkę? W życiu!

source_text: It looks nice.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.It looks nice.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.It looks nice."

translation: Ładnie w niej wyglądasz.

source_text: Everything looks nice on me, 1Hero. Hasn’t your mom raised you with some manners?

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Everything looks nice on me, 1Hero. Hasn’t your mom raised you with some manners?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Everything looks nice on me, 1Hero. Hasn’t your mom raised you with some manners?"

translation: We wszystkim mi ładnie, 1Hero. Mama nie nauczyła cię dobrych manier?

source_text: I didn’t mean…

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I didn’t mean…
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I didn’t mean…"

translation: Nie to miałem na myśli…

source_text: I know just the thing!

structure.raw_value: KiHaOp.I know just the thing!
structure.script_literal: "KiHaOp.I know just the thing!"

translation: Wiem, co będzie odpowiednie!

source_text: Here. Put this on.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx#.Here. Put this on.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx#.Here. Put this on."

translation: Proszę. Załóż to.

source_text: What, right here?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.What, right here?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.What, right here?"

translation: Co, tutaj?

source_text: Keep your underwear on, creep.

structure.raw_value: KiAnOp.Keep your underwear on, creep.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnOp.Keep your underwear on, creep."

translation: Zostaw majtki na sobie, zboczeńcu.

source_text: My name is 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.My name is 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.My name is 1Hero."

translation: Mam na imię 1Hero.

source_text: Okay, 1Hero. Keep your panties on, but change into this shirt and pants.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Okay, 1Hero. Keep your panties on, but change into this shirt and pants.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Okay, 1Hero. Keep your panties on, but change into this shirt and pants."

translation: Dobrze, 1Hero. Zostaw majtki, ale załóż tę koszulę i spodnie.

source_text: Fine. Give it to me.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Fine. Give it to me.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Fine. Give it to me."

translation: Dobra. Daj mi je.

source_text: Looks like someone works out.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp#.Looks like someone works out.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp#.Looks like someone works out."

translation: Widzę, że ktoś tu ćwiczy.

source_text: Oh, heh. Yeah. I’m in pretty good shape, I guess.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Oh, heh. Yeah. I’m in pretty good shape, I guess.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Oh, heh. Yeah. I’m in pretty good shape, I guess."

translation: Och, heh. No. Chyba jestem w całkiem niezłej formie.

source_text: You better not outshine me, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.You better not outshine me, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.You better not outshine me, 1Hero."

translation: Lepiej mnie nie przyćmij, 1Hero.

source_text: Haha. I’ll try not to.

structure.raw_value: McHaOpNo4.Haha. I’ll try not to.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOpNo4.Haha. I’ll try not to."

translation: Haha. Postaram się.

source_text: Hurry up. The show starts soon and we have to get you some makeup.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Hurry up. The show starts soon and we have to get you some makeup.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Hurry up. The show starts soon and we have to get you some makeup."

translation: Pospiesz się. Program zaraz się zacznie, a musimy jeszcze zrobić ci makijaż.

source_text: Makeup? I thought only girls wore makeup.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Makeup? I thought only girls wore makeup.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Makeup? I thought only girls wore makeup."

translation: Makijaż? Myślałem, że tylko dziewczyny go noszą.

source_text: You’re lucky you are cute, big boy.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.You’re lucky you are cute, big boy.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.You’re lucky you are cute, big boy."

translation: Masz szczęście, że jesteś słodki, byczku.

source_text: Get dressed and let’s look you over.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Get dressed and let’s look you over.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Get dressed and let’s look you over."

translation: Ubierz się, a potem cię obejrzymy.

source_text: Handsome and professional, but most importantly of all… boring.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx#.Handsome and professional, but most importantly of all… boring.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx#.Handsome and professional, but most importantly of all… boring."

translation: Przystojny i profesjonalny, ale przede wszystkim… nudny.

source_text: Is boring good?

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.Is boring good?
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.Is boring good?"

translation: Nuda to dobrze?

source_text: No need to upstage the star.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.No need to upstage the star.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.No need to upstage the star."

translation: Nie musisz przyćmiewać gwiazdy.

source_text: I’ll take your word on that.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I’ll take your word on that.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I’ll take your word on that."

translation: Skoro tak mówisz.

source_text: A lot of little boys would kill to be in your position right now.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp#.A lot of little boys would kill to be in your position right now.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp#.A lot of little boys would kill to be in your position right now."

translation: Wielu chłopców dałoby się pokroić, żeby być teraz na twoim miejscu.

source_text: Not sure how many boys would enjoy putting makeup on.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Not sure how many boys would enjoy putting makeup on.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Not sure how many boys would enjoy putting makeup on."

translation: Nie wiem, ilu chłopakom spodobałoby się nakładanie makijażu.

source_text: You think that’s what I meant?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.You think that’s what I meant?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.You think that’s what I meant?"

translation: Myślisz, że to miałam na myśli?

source_text: I’m playing it smooth. Is it working?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I’m playing it smooth. Is it working?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I’m playing it smooth. Is it working?"

translation: Próbuję być czarujący. Działa?

source_text: Don’t get your hopes up, Detective Cantaloupe.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Don’t get your hopes up, Detective Cantaloupe.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Don’t get your hopes up, Detective Cantaloupe."

translation: Nie rób sobie nadziei, detektywie Melonie.

source_text: Canmore.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Canmore."

translation: Canmore.

source_text: Now that’s what I call a face for television.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp#.Now that’s what I call a face for television.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp#.Now that’s what I call a face for television."

translation: No, to jest twarz stworzona do telewizji.

source_text: Yeah. Totally different than before.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Yeah. Totally different than before.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Yeah. Totally different than before."

translation: Tak. Zupełnie inaczej niż wcześniej.

source_text: It’s almost showtime. I better get dressed.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.It’s almost showtime. I better get dressed.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.It’s almost showtime. I better get dressed."

translation: Zaraz zaczynamy. Lepiej się ubiorę.

source_text: No peeking.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.No peeking.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.No peeking."

translation: Nie podglądaj.

source_text: So, tell me, detective: How long have you been on the Eclipse Guild case?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp#.So, tell me, detective: How long have you been on the Eclipse Guild case?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp#.So, tell me, detective: How long have you been on the Eclipse Guild case?"

translation: Powiedz mi, detektywie: jak długo zajmujesz się sprawą Gildii Zaćmienia?

source_text: Oh, uhh. I transferred over from another case. I’m still learning.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Oh, uhh. I transferred over from another case. I’m still learning.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Oh, uhh. I transferred over from another case. I’m still learning."

translation: Och, eee… Przeniesiono mnie z innej sprawy. Wciąż się uczę.

source_text: I see how it is.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.I see how it is.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.I see how it is."

translation: Aha, rozumiem.

source_text: The commissioner will have most of the details for you.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.The commissioner will have most of the details for you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.The commissioner will have most of the details for you."

translation: Komisarz przekaże ci większość szczegółów.

source_text: She wants you here because you’ll look good to the public. You know that, right?

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.She wants you here because you’ll look good to the public. You know that, right?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.She wants you here because you’ll look good to the public. You know that, right?"

translation: Chce cię tu, bo dobrze zaprezentujesz się przed opinią publiczną. Wiesz o tym, prawda?

source_text: I suspected as much.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I suspected as much.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I suspected as much."

translation: Tego się domyślałem.

source_text: Word on the street is that there are only a few dozen members left unaccounted for.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp#.Word on the street is that there are only a few dozen members left unaccounted for.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp#.Word on the street is that there are only a few dozen members left unaccounted for."

translation: Chodzą słuchy, że nie odnaleziono już tylko kilkudziesięciu członków.

source_text: What are your sources?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What are your sources?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What are your sources?"

translation: Skąd masz te informacje?

source_text: After today, it’ll be you. I hope you’re smarter than your age lets on.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.After today, it’ll be you. I hope you’re smarter than your age lets on.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.After today, it’ll be you. I hope you’re smarter than your age lets on."

translation: Po dzisiejszym dniu to ty będziesz moim źródłem. Obyś był mądrzejszy, niż wskazuje na to twój wiek.

source_text: Don’t worry about me. I know enough.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Don’t worry about me. I know enough.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Don’t worry about me. I know enough."

translation: Nie martw się o mnie. Wiem wystarczająco dużo.

source_text: I can tell Commissioner Kimura wants softballs. But, just so you know, I plan on digging up dirt.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp#.I can tell Commissioner Kimura wants softballs. But, just so you know, I plan on digging up dirt.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp#.I can tell Commissioner Kimura wants softballs. But, just so you know, I plan on digging up dirt."

translation: Widzę, że komisarz Kimura liczy na łatwe pytania. Ale uprzedzam: zamierzam wyciągnąć brudy.

source_text: With a little luck, this whole thing will be over in a month.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.With a little luck, this whole thing will be over in a month.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.With a little luck, this whole thing will be over in a month."

translation: Przy odrobinie szczęścia za miesiąc będzie po wszystkim.

source_text: She’s taught you well.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.She’s taught you well.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.She’s taught you well."

translation: Dobrze cię wyszkoliła.

source_text: She thinks you’ll influence the public’s opinion on the police force in this state…

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp#.She thinks you’ll influence the public’s opinion on the police force in this state…
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp#.She thinks you’ll influence the public’s opinion on the police force in this state…"

translation: Uważa, że wpłyniesz na opinię mieszkańców o policji w tym stanie…

source_text: But nothing gets by me. Don’t forget that.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.But nothing gets by me. Don’t forget that.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.But nothing gets by me. Don’t forget that."

translation: Ale nic mi nie umyka. Nie zapominaj o tym.

source_text: If you want to influence the people, you’ll need me on your team.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp#.If you want to influence the people, you’ll need me on your team.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp#.If you want to influence the people, you’ll need me on your team."

translation: Jeśli chcesz wpłynąć na ludzi, będziesz mnie potrzebować w swoim zespole.

source_text: We’re all on the same team, Miss Foxx. The Guild is the enemy.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.We’re all on the same team, Miss Foxx. The Guild is the enemy.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.We’re all on the same team, Miss Foxx. The Guild is the enemy."

translation: Gramy do jednej bramki, panno Foxx. Wrogiem jest Gildia.

source_text: If what you say is true, backlash is the enemy now.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.If what you say is true, backlash is the enemy now.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.If what you say is true, backlash is the enemy now."

translation: Jeśli to prawda, naszym wrogiem są teraz konsekwencje.

source_text: You and I can make a great team, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp#.You and I can make a great team, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp#.You and I can make a great team, 1Hero."

translation: Razem możemy stworzyć świetny zespół, 1Hero.

source_text: I’m here to help you. I’ll do what I can.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I’m here to help you. I’ll do what I can.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I’m here to help you. I’ll do what I can."

translation: Jestem tu, żeby ci pomóc. Zrobię, co w mojej mocy.

source_text: People trust me. Let’s keep it that way.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.People trust me. Let’s keep it that way.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.People trust me. Let’s keep it that way."

translation: Ludzie mi ufają. Niech tak zostanie.

source_text: We’re an open book. We’re not hiding anything.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We’re an open book. We’re not hiding anything.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We’re an open book. We’re not hiding anything."

translation: Nie mamy nic do ukrycia. Wszystko jest jawne.
